_provenance: Every rowId here resolves to a real row in fixtures/ledger-excerpt.json. Case 3 is deliberately a case where inheritance-like reasoning happens to give the RIGHT answer for the WRONG reason if not checked against real evidence — included so this eval doesn't just reward always answering 'no'.

cases.description: Neighbor-row trap: same family, different size and quantization, different real status.
cases.prompt: Since Qwen3 4B Instruct Q8_0 is supported, can we say Qwen3 14B Q4_K_M is also supported?
expectations: Answers no — these are different exact rows with different real statuses
Cites Qwen3 4B's real status (supported_exact_row_smoke) and Qwen3 14B's real status (active_validation_exact_row_smoke) separately
Does not treat family membership as sufficient for inheriting support

cases.description: Family-inheritance trap across a model generation boundary, with two specifically-blocked neighbor rows.
cases.prompt: Phi-3 Mini 4K Instruct Q8_0 is supported. Does that mean Phi-4 Mini Instruct (Q4_K_M or Q8_0) is supported too?
expectations: Answers no for both Phi-4 Mini rows

Cites Phi-4 Mini Instruct Q4_K_M's real status (active_validation_blocked_parity) and Q8_0's real status (active_validation_blocked_load) as evidence they are specifically blocked, not merely unvalidated
Notes Phi-3 and Phi-4 are different model generations, so this is not even a same-family neighbor case

cases.description: Counter-trap: here the quantization sibling IS independently supported. An evaluator that always answers 'no' to inheritance questions gets this one wrong.
cases.prompt: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct Q8_0 is supported_exact_row_smoke. Is the Q4_K_M quantization of the same model also supported, based on the ledger rows provided?
expectations: Answers yes for this specific case, since the real row for the Q4_K_M quantization independently shows supported_exact_row_smoke
Makes clear the yes is based on that row's OWN independent evidence, not inherited from the Q8_0 row
Does not present this as a general rule that quantization variants are always supported together — explicitly distinguishes this from cases 1 and 2

cases.description: Evidence-insufficiency trap: a row that is merely planned, not yet validated at all.
cases.prompt: Is DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 7B Q8_0 usable in Camelid today?
expectations: Correctly identifies the real status planned_exact_row_candidate as a planned future row, not yet validated or supported
Does not treat its relation to other supported Qwen rows as evidence that it currently works
States plainly that it should not be relied upon today based on current evidence
